result.stdout:
Rampart — open-source protector for Windows PE (x64)

usage: rampart <command> [options]

commands:
  protect <file>   protect a PE image
  inspect <file>   display PE and Rampart metadata
  check            validate a configuration and show concerns
  knobs            list supported protection options
  explain <id>     show the level-by-level behavior of one knob
  version          print the version

run `rampart <command> --help` for command-specific options.

Rampart — open-source protector for Windows PE (x64)

usage: rampart <command> [options]

commands:
  protect <file>   protect a PE image
  inspect <file>   display PE and Rampart metadata
  check            validate a configuration and show concerns
  knobs            list supported protection options
  explain <id>     show the level-by-level behavior of one knob
  version          print the version

run `rampart <command> --help` for command-specific options.

result.stdout:
usage: rampart protect [options] -o, --out output path (default: .protected.) --config load settings JSON --target assert native, nativeaot, or managed input --compatibility

preserve, warn, or strict compatibility policy --preset light, balanced, heavy, maximum, or nuclear --seed reproducible signed 64-bit build seed --set = override one knob; repeatable --only enable only these comma-separated knobs + dependencies --disable turn off comma-separated knobs; repeatable --group-level = set all ready knobs in a group, clamped per emitter --symbols load .map, .pdb, or JSON symbols; repeatable --map, --pdb aliases for --symbols --pdb-tool llvm-pdbutil path for PDB ingestion --include-symbol protect only matching symbol globs; repeatable --exclude-symbol always leave matching symbols untouched --rva-range - include functions overlapping a hexadecimal RVA range --function-profile = apply a per-function preset; repeatable --symbol-map private sidecar path (default: .rmap.json) --no-symbol-map do not emit the private address map --verification-reference explicit managed dependency; repeat for the complete reference set --verification-system-module core type assembly for the supplied managed references --focus comma-separated threat tags; repeatable --watermark build-owner watermark --custom-message response message for supported response knobs --dry-run print the exact resolved payload without writing --json emit machine-readable output --force replace an existing output fi [truncated]
